You will report to the Infra Operations Manager. You will play a vital role in delivering a reliable, secure, and automated IT foundation for the business by: Configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting network infrastructure across offices, stores, and warehouses, as well as networking in our public cloud environments Planning and executing network changes and upgrades, monitoring performance and capacity, and carrying out root cause analysis on recurring faults Administering our endpoint management platform and cloud identity services, including device compliance, application deployment, conditional access, and single sign-on Operating compute, storage, and micro services in a cloud-first hybrid environment, together with our collaboration and productivity services, including backup and restore Maintaining security compliance across networks, servers, and endpoints through patching, threat protection, hardening, and certificate management Contributing to the migration of remaining on-premises workloads and services to the cloud, and to the decommissioning programme running until end of 2027 Taking part in Incident, Problem, and Change Management, acting as escalation tier for network operations, security operations, and customer support Developing scripts for automation and monitoring, and keeping documentation and configuration data accurate in our ITSM platform Collaborating with development, service delivery, and business teams to keep critical systems available around the clock, including taking part in the on-call rotation and travelling to sites when required WHO YOU ARE You have high aspirations and focus on details that create substantial impact. Cooperation, respect, and clear communication are important, along with your ambition to learn and grow. If these qualities speak to you, we would love to have you on our team.
